title: This month
description: Daily check: how much of each bucket is left this month, and whether spending runs ahead of the usual timing.

list.name: month
list.label: Month
list.description: The month every panel shows. Defaults to the latest month, the current one.
list.query: select to_char(month_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as __value, to_char(month_start, 'Mon YYYY') as __text from marts.fct_month_plan order by month_start desc
list.definition: select to_char(month_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as __value, to_char(month_start, 'Mon YYYY') as __text from marts.fct_month_plan order by month_start desc

panels.title: Status
panels.description: How far to trust the rest of the dashboard today: the day of the month, how much of the expected spendable income has arrived, and how many complete months the 'usual' figures average (3 is the full baseline; fewer is thin).

targets.rawSql:
select
  case
    when p.as_of_day = 0 then 'Not started'
    when p.is_complete_month then 'Complete month'
    else 'Day ' || p.as_of_day || ' of ' || p.days_in_month
  end
  || ' · ' ||
  case
    when p.income_received_share is null then 'no expected income yet'
    else 'income received ' || round(p.income_received_share * 100) || '% of expected'
  end
  || ' · ' ||
  case
    when p.baseline_months = 0 then 'no baseline yet'
    when p.baseline_months = 1 then 'baseline: 1 month (thin)'
    when p.baseline_months < 3 then 'baseline: ' || p.baseline_months || ' months (thin)'
    else 'baseline ' || p.baseline_months || ' months'
  end as status
from marts.fct_month_plan p
where p.month_start = '${month}'

panels.title: Wants left
panels.description: Can I buy this want now? The wants plan for the month minus wants spent so far, and that amount spread over the days left (today included). A negative amount, in red, is how far over the plan wants already are. A complete month shows what was left at its end. 'No baseline yet' means there is no plan to compare with.

targets.rawSql:
select label, amount
from (
  select 1 as ord,
    case when p.is_complete_month then 'Wants left at month end' else 'Wants left' end as label,
    p.wants_plan - s.wants_spend as amount
  from marts.fct_month_plan p
  join marts.fct_monthly_summary s using (month_start)
  where month_start = '${month}'
  union all
  select 2, '≈ per remaining day',
    round((p.wants_plan - s.wants_spend) / (p.days_in_month - greatest(p.as_of_day, 1) + 1), 2)
  from marts.fct_month_plan p
  join marts.fct_monthly_summary s using (month_start)
  where month_start = '${month}' and not p.is_complete_month
) t
order by ord

panels.title: Buckets this month
panels.description: Which bucket is running hot? Plan, used so far and left for each bucket, the share of the plan used, and the share of a month usually done by today (mean of the up-to-3 complete months before). Status compares the two: more than 10 points ahead or behind the usual timing, else on pace. The financial-future row's Left is what is still to move by month end; it is due then, so it is never flagged early, and reads 'Done ✓' once moved.

targets.rawSql:
with p as (
  select * from marts.fct_month_plan where month_start = '${month}'
), s as (
  select * from marts.fct_monthly_summary where month_start = '${month}'
), b as (
  select 1 as ord, 'Needs' as bucket, 'needs' as series, p.needs_plan as plan, s.needs_spend as used from p, s
  union all
  select 2, 'Wants', 'wants', p.wants_plan, s.wants_spend from p, s
  union all
  select 3, 'Financial future', 'financial_future', p.financial_future_plan, s.financial_future from p, s
)
select
  b.bucket as "Bucket",
  b.plan as "Plan",
  b.used as "Used",
  case when b.series = 'financial_future' then greatest(b.plan - b.used, 0) else b.plan - b.used end as "Left",
  round(b.used / nullif(b.plan, 0), 4) as "Used %",
  d.pace_share_avg_3m as "Usual by today %",
  case
    when b.series = 'financial_future' then
      case when b.used >= b.plan then 'Done ✓' else 'due by month end' end
    when b.plan is null or d.pace_share_avg_3m is null then 'no pace yet'
    when b.used / nullif(b.plan, 0) - d.pace_share_avg_3m > 0.10 then '▲ ahead of usual pace'
    when b.used / nullif(b.plan, 0) - d.pace_share_avg_3m < -0.10 then '▼ behind usual pace'
    else '● on pace'
  end as "Status"
from b
cross join p
left join marts.fct_pace_day d
  on d.series = b.series
  and p.as_of_day > 0
  and d.date_day = p.month_start + (p.as_of_day - 1)
order by b.ord

panels.title: Wants: this month vs usual
panels.description: Am I ahead of my usual timing? Wants spent so far this month (stops at today), what the up-to-3 complete months before usually had by the same day, and the wants plan spread at that usual timing (dashed: a target). With no baseline yet, only this month's line is drawn. The chart shows the dashboard's time range, this month by default; set the time picker to match when choosing an earlier month.

targets.rawSql:
select
  (d.date_day::timestamp at time zone 'America/Toronto') as time,
  d.amount_mtd as "This month",
  d.pace_mtd_avg_3m as "Usual by this day",
  round(p.wants_plan * d.pace_share_avg_3m, 2) as "Plan at your usual timing"
from marts.fct_pace_day d
join marts.fct_month_plan p using (month_start)
where month_start = '${month}' and d.series = 'wants'
order by 1

panels.title: Everyday needs: this month vs usual
panels.description: Are groceries and transit running hot? Variable needs spent so far this month (stops at today) against what the up-to-3 complete months before usually had by the same day. No plan line: the needs plan also covers fixed needs, so a variable-only plan would be invented. The chart shows the dashboard's time range, this month by default.

targets.rawSql:
select
  (d.date_day::timestamp at time zone 'America/Toronto') as time,
  d.amount_mtd as "This month",
  d.pace_mtd_avg_3m as "Usual by this day"
from marts.fct_pace_day d
where d.month_start = '${month}' and d.series = 'variable_needs'
order by 1

panels.title: Where wants went this month
panels.description: Which category is eating wants? Wants spent this month by category, largest first, beside the usual spend for the whole month (mean of the up-to-3 complete months before). Mid-month, a bar near its whole-month usual means that category is already close to a normal month's total.

targets.rawSql:
select
  category_name as category,
  sum(spend) as "This month",
  sum(spend_avg_3m) as "Usual for the whole month"
from marts.fct_subcategory_month
where month_start = '${month}' and bucket = 'wants'
group by category_name
having sum(spend) > 0 or sum(spend_avg_3m) > 0
order by 2 desc, 1
